testsuite.name: com.systemwebstudio.publish.StoredArtifactVerifierTests

testcase.name: a limit of zero never re-reads, and an artifact above the limit keeps the cheap check - the gateway still hashes what it serves()
an intact artifact passes both checks()
the content check also finds a missing file, and a file of the wrong size is found by both()
a removed or unknown artifact and a changed manifest fail whatever the mode()
a file replaced by other bytes of the SAME size passes the cheap check and is caught by the content check()
